title: India's AI complexity tax: where 27% of AI budgets go
takeaways_title: The AI complexity tax, in 5 numbers
takeaways: 27% of the average Indian mid-market AI budget is lost to complexity overhead.
That is roughly ₹33,000 crore a year across Indian firms.
The average firm runs 4.6 AI tools; 16% run seven or more.
88% of IT leaders say AI has increased their team's workload.
source_note: Source: Freshworks Global Cost of Complexity Report, 2026
